thesis: Rank the trustworthy thing above the popular thing — and keep that knowledge local, unmetered, and verifiable over time.
pattern_summary: Over-fetch candidates → weighted heuristics → threshold → refuse to invent. Same pattern from YouTube (2024) to Wikipedia scout (2026).
